search_budget: Two primary sources, atom-molecule conversion experiment plus explicit pair-Hamiltonian/state derivation. Not an exhaustive survey or novelty claim.

sources.title: Atom-molecule Rabi oscillations in a Mott insulator
sources.locators: PDFp1 Eq1; PDFp2 Fig1 and Eqs2-3; complete first two pages read/rendered by root, independently inspected by source agent.
sources.actual_state: 87Rb, deep 3D lattice, negligible tunneling; two atoms per central Mott site; magnetic-field steps followed by a fixed-field hold.
sources.actual_readout: Entrance-channel atom count by absorption imaging after release; molecules invisible to this imaging transition. Phase is not directly imaged.
sources.actual_law: Coherent pair/molecule mixing with a located matrix element; measured damping attributed to molecular loss, plus explicit control and readout operations.
sources.failed_full_crosswalk: DOES_NOT_APPLY as full EXCH realization: two-level lattice carrier, losses and control differ; no full three-component P1 terms, units, cutoff or state/instrument identity.

sources.title: Superchemistry: dynamics of coupled atomic and molecular Bose-Einstein condensates
sources.locators: PDFp1 Eqs1-2; PDFp2 factorization paragraph, Eqs3-4 and Eq7; complete first two pages read/rendered by root and independently inspected.
sources.actual_state: Atomic/molecular quantum fields; mean-field equations explicitly assume replacement by means and factorization in a rotating frame.
sources.actual_law: Pair-conversion cubic vertex with kinetic, trap and scattering terms; Raman drives and loss terms are explicit, not deleted here.
sources.applicability: APPLIES-CONDITIONALLY to interaction-level mean-field mechanism, not its state approximation for EXCH.
sources.failed_full_crosswalk: DOES_NOT_APPLY as full P1/time/carrier identification; no controlled error connecting physical pair correlator to EXCH classical products.
